label: after-fold
workload: Warm up; 4 fold/unfold cycles, native taps and 1200ms waits. End screen checked for the fold control. Same 11 books and QA fixtures. Only Scene, PaperSurface and BookmarkCard swapped against turn-start baseline.
environment: Android API36 emulator; Expo Go development bundle; QA polling. One sample per version, not a device-wide speed claim.
summaryScope: First aggregate block in dumpsys gfxinfo. Includes emulator overhead; small sample and mixed p50/p95 results do not establish a general speedup.
